finding: Preceding context plus punctuation-only heading scoring restores How and She stopped in ASR, unlike earlier short-input attempts. C/see and aloud/allowed are orthographic homophones. I'll/I is an unresolved neighboring contraction discrepancy.
decision: Do not promote this merged audition or replace production takes. Retain evidence that contextual input can recover the heading; a production change still requires bounded coverage and join validation without sacrificing neighboring words.
